title: ח׳ אל־ביודאת (Kh. el-Beiyudat)
author: H. Hizmi
location_note: About 2 km north of el-ʿAuja, east of the Jordan Valley road.
notes: Byzantine church (6th-early 7th c. CE) and buildings; Herodian lamp fragments among the earliest finds. CLAIM: identification with Migdal Sennaa or Archelais. No feature of the eligible classes. No English version among the phase-2 ESI 5-6 reports.

title: מצודת בלמונט (צובה) (Belmont Castle, Zuba)
author: R. Harper, D. Pringle
notes: Crusader castle destroyed 1191; village above. Built underground structure (not eligible).

features.subtype: three large cisterns occupying most of the west part of the courtyard
features.quote: שלושה בורות מים גדולים תפסו את רוב

features.subtype: winepress in the north-east corner of the courtyard
